# IndustrialCoatings.co

> IndustrialCoatings.co - The #1 Industrial Coatings Contractor Network in North America

IndustrialCoatings.co connects facility owners, general contractors, and plant managers with verified industrial coatings contractors across 500+ cities in North America.

## Services

- Protective & Corrosion Coatings: Heavy-duty coatings for structural steel, tanks, and infrastructure to SSPC/NACE standards.
- Epoxy & Resinous Flooring: Seamless epoxy, urethane, and polyaspartic floor systems for warehouses, plants, and food-grade facilities.
- Tank Linings & Secondary Containment: Immersion-grade interior linings and containment coatings for water, fuel, and chemical storage.
- Intumescent Fireproofing: Passive fire-protection coatings for structural steel, rated for code compliance.
- Abrasive Blasting & Surface Prep: Blasting, power-tool cleaning, and surface profiling to specification.
- Pipeline & Facility Coatings: Field and shop coatings for pipelines, refineries, water treatment, marine, and heavy industry.
